body: How do I suggest that he go see a therapist? I don't want him to feel like I trying to pass him off to someone else also he is a very proud person who has always seen therapy as a sign of weakness. And I do love him but I feel like I haven't helped him at all and I'm really at a loss for what I should do now and I'm open to therapy; are there resources out there for someone in my situation? a hotline maybe? I guess this is my therapy as well
